Ingredients

2 tbsp olive oil

200g chicken breast

1/2 cup of original ricotta

zest of 1 lemon

1 tbsp finely chopped basil or 1/2 teasp of dried basil

1 pizza base

2 cups of shredded pizza cheese

1 small zucchini, finely sliced

2 tbsp of small basil leaves, extra

Method

Preheat the oven to 250oC.

Heat the oil in a small fry pan and cook the chicken over medium heat for 4-5 mins on each side until golden brown and cooked through. Put on a plate and cover with foil to rest and cool for 5 mins. Shred or slice the chicken.

Mix the ricotta, lemon zest and finely chopped basil, season with salt and pepper then spread over the pizza base. Sprinkle with 1&1/2 cups of shredded pizza cheese, top with sliced zucchini and chicken then sprinkle over the rest of the cheese.

Bake for 10-20 mins until melty and golden and the base is crispy.

Sprinkle with extra basil leaves.
